ns2:section.sectionText: Labs Meet in 0218 Siebel Center Topic: Programming Lab is intended to strengthen the programming skills of students who have completed CS125. Focus will be on practical skills in constructing completed code in a methodical, reliable way. Code form and approach to construction will be stressed. Students will learn proper commenting, naming and formatting of their source code, Test Driven Development and unit testing. Students will learn some Ruby and C++. This class is intended for students that have completed CS 125 but have not taken CS 225.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Computer Science or Statistics & Computer Science or Math & Computer Science major(s). Restricted to students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
